item.text: {"critiques":[{"candidate_id":"header-merge-baseline-v1","claim_links":{"c1":[],"c2":[],"x1":["f1"],"x2":["f1"],"x3":["f1"],"x4":[]},"result":{"findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Headers with different casing remain separate entries, so replacement does not preserve the first position or emit only the last spelling and value.","evidence":"header_merge.py:10-11 — defaults={'A':'old','B':'v'} and overrides={'a':'new'} produce {'A':'old','B':'v','a':'new'}.","claim_ids":["x1","x2","x3"]}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}},{"candidate_id":"cutover-plan-baseline-v1","claim_links":{"c1":[],"c2":["f1"],"x1":[],"x2":["f2"],"x3":["f3"],"x4":["f4"]},"result":{"findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"The plan has no tenant-specific migration or recovery steps.","evidence":"decision.json:13-43 — every step and rollback action is global; none identifies a tenant or a tenant-specific checkpoint or route.","claim_ids":["c2"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Dual writes and a read-only flip leave write authority undefined.","evidence":"decision.json:4,16-33 — the strategy enables dual writes, then flips reads, with no atomic change of the authoritative write store.","claim_ids":["x2"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Backfill has no durable tenant checkpoint or specified retry behavior.","evidence":"decision.json:21-26 — the backfill step contains no checkpoint, resume, or idempotency mechanism.","claim_ids":["x3"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Cutover lacks a compare-and-swap and the required evidence gates.","evidence":"decision.json:27-38 — flip_reads follows backfill; the manual gate requires only count_match, with no high-watermark or verification evidence.","claim_ids":["x4"]}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}}],"schema_version":1}
